test_bowl_on_rack_task: test the BowlOnRack task by creating a composer Environment and running 5 reset-step cycles
run_bowl_on_rack_test: run the unittest test_bowl_on_rack to render overhead camera images of the bowl on rack scene
create_bowl_on_rack_environment: create a composer Environment with BowlOnRack task using a fixed random seed and control timestep
render_overhead_camera_images: render overhead camera images from the physics environment and save them as PNG files to /tmp
review_bowl_on_rack_tests: review the BowlOnRackTests class and its test_bowl_on_rack method for simulation task validation
